xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #6041

plan.title: ci(coverage): take the coverage run off the merge path; run it at release Step 5 ("release for now or on demand")

narratives.Description: ci(coverage): take the coverage run off the merge path; run it at release Step 5 ("release for now or on demand")
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — CI ci-lane and ordinary ts:check-lane run vitest without --coverage; invert today's Step-5 no-coverage polarity so only RELEASE_PREFLIGHT Step 5 sets hostCoverage true
- relieves: P2 — Step 5 enforces host --coverage thresholds; remove tip-SHA GHA coverage-of-record cites from preflight success, stamp-hit, and auto-hatch success; flip suite-bound step5HostCoverage expectation to true in the same change so debt-hatch freshness matches the host report
- relieves: P3 — verify:forward-coverage: missing/unreadable report without --enforce prints visible not-measured and exits 0; missing/unreadable report with --enforce exits non-zero even on an empty diff; new-file correspondence stays fail-closed always
- relieves: P4 — Suite stamp skips only with a mechanical host-coverage witness old schemaVersion-1 stamps lack (bump or required field → miss); pass_with_debt requires a positive debtIssue on read; witness is minted only from a completed host coverage run or suite-bound debt classification, never from env selection alone
narratives.Labels: bug, chore, process, area:release, dogfood, design-critique:ingest-ready, core-capabilities, promise:gates
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want PR merge CI to run tests without --coverage and host coverage only at release Step 5, so every PR does not pay a double coverage tax.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Prefer-A Bound 6610301685: ci-lane + ordinary ts:check-lane without --coverage; Step 5 hostCoverage true; remove GHA coverage-of-record cites; forward-coverage missing-report honesty; suite-stamp host-coverage witness.
